title: S03T02 - Implement remote bootstrap, push, pull, and offline rejoin
description: Provide one supported way for a second clone to acquire Boreal state, work offline, exchange changes, and verify shared-history identity without manual file copying.
acceptanceCriteria: A new clone can bootstrap from a configured remote and verify project identity, schema compatibility, and current generation.
Push, pull, and offline rejoin are idempotent, previewable, bounded, and never mutate application Git history implicitly.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
